paper_id: Energy-effective artificial internet-of-things application deployment in edge-cloud systems
title: Energy-effective artificial internet-of-things application deployment in edge-cloud systems
motivation: 边缘服务器资源受限且能耗高,部署AIoT服务时需权衡性能与成本
problem_framing: 将AIoT应用建模为DAG,转化为双目标优化问题CA3D
key_insight: 利用DAG刻画服务依赖关系,通过MOEA/D在Pareto前沿搜索性能-能耗平衡解
method_signature: MOEA/D分解式多目标进化算法,结合遗传算子求解CA3D
evaluation_criteria: Pareto前沿覆盖度、Hyper-volume指标、Alibaba集群与Montage工作流数据集
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 方案仅提供良好起点,在快速变化环境下无法保证效率
evidence_for_taste: we are going to consider the uncertainty
the proposed solution may not guarantee its efficiency
we turn to the heuristic method like MOEA/D
try to find some sub-optimal solutions
thinking_moves: 将AI模型(如DeepFM)视为DAG结构,继承深度学习工作流建模习惯
把性能-能耗联合优化问题拆解为标量子问题并行求解
从物理电路特性出发建立能耗模型(E∝f²)
承认启发式方法只能找到次优解,明确算法适用范围
